output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function can only be executed by the owner, which makes it unusable for crowdsale. Moreover, the function name is misspelled 'mintToken' instead of 'mintingToken'.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. In the function '_transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);', it does not check if '_value' is zero, and if 'balanceOf[msg.sender]' is larger than '_value'. If it is, the 'balanceOf[_to]' += _value; statement will cause an overflow, reducing the balance of the sender and causing the transfer to be not completed.
